samples.question: The picture shows four closed curves and one black dot on a plain background. Each curve is painted as a ring of short dashes of one colour, so its outline is broken by small gaps; the gaps are openings in the drawing only, and every curve is still one closed loop that comes back to where it started. No curve crosses or touches another curve, no region is filled, and the colours, the sizes, the positions of the curves, the number of dashes and the total amount of ink carry no information. A curve encloses the black dot when the dot lies in the region shut in by that closed loop. How many of the four curves enclose the black dot? Answer 0, 1, 2 or 3.
